description:
Starts from a loss the reader cannot absorb and reports the least extreme
        combination of market moves that would produce it, beside the worst each of
        those moves actually did in the record. No probability is computed.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

loss.description: The loss to explain, as a fraction: 0.25 = lose a quarter.
loss.title: Loss

name: reverse_stress

outputSchema.description: The least extreme market moves that would produce the given loss.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

coverage.description: Share of the portfolio's movement these directions explain.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

line.description: One sentence: what it would take.

moves.description: Per market direction: label, plain wording, shock needed, sensitivity (beta), share of the loss, worst_seen in the record over the same number of days.

target.description: The loss explained, as a negative fraction.

window_days.description: Length of the move considered, in trading days.

title: What it would take to lose that much
